title: TSOTİ
description: Takes a clean, professional screenshot of your inventory.
body:
📸 Take Screenshot Of The Inventory (TSOTI)

An inventory capture utility designed for sharing clean layout screenshots.

Developed by Markesr

--- ## 🔍 What is TSOTI? **Take Screenshot Of The Inventory (TSOTI)** is a utility mod that allows you to take cropped screenshots of your in-game inventory. Instead of manually cropping full-screen screenshots, TSOTI isolates the inventory interface and exports it as a framed image. It is designed for showcasing gear, sharing loadouts, or keeping track of storage content. ### ⚡ Key Functionality & Performance * **GUI Capture:** Hooks into the game's GUI rendering to capture the inventory frame directly when the hotkey is pressed. * **Automated Cropping:** Trims outer screen space to focus precisely on the inventory slots. * **Inventory Summary Option:** Generates a categorized text list of your items alongside the image file to show item counts clearly. --- ### 🛠️ Available Features * **GUI Color Themes:** Customize the background style of your exported screenshots. Available options include: Dark, Midnight Blue, Cherry Blossom, Gold, Matrix, Light, or Transparent (for external editing). * **Adjustable Padding:** Modify the inner and outer padding borders of the screenshot via the config menu to change the crop size. * **Language Support:** Utilizes Minecraft's native `I18n` engine to support English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (BR), and Polish. * **Configuration Menu:** Change themes, padding size, and toggle the text summary on the fly using the in-game config screen. ### 📥 Dependencies To use this mod, please ensure you have the following installed: * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) * [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) * [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(Required to access the in-game settings menu)* ---
